notes.title: BACKROOMS: We Escape Forever - Update Schedule Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hello BACKROOMS players 👋[/p][p]We’re currently developing a new Soulslike game called *Lunathren*,  [/p][p]so the upcoming update for **BACKROOMS: We Escape Forever** may be slightly delayed.[/p][p]That said, development for BACKROOMS is not on hold —  [/p][p]we’re still committed to delivering updates and responding to your feedback 🙇‍♂️[/p][p]The next content update is in progress, and we’re working to ensure the quality meets your expectations.  [/p][p]Please stay tuned, and thank you for your patience and continued support 💛[/p][p]— Ziegler Studio[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.6.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Improvements:

Increased player sprint stamina. You can now run for longer without getting tired!

Fixes:

Fixed an issue where only the host’s name would appear in the lobby. Now, all players’ names in the room are properly displayed and synchronized.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support 💛 Stay tuned for more updates!




기능 개선:

캐릭터의 달리기 스태미너가 증가했습니다. 이제 더 오래 달릴 수 있습니다!

문제 해결:

로비에서 발생한 호스트 이름만 표시되는 동기화 문제가 수정되었습니다. 이제 방에 있는 모든 참가자의 이름이 정확히 표시됩니다.

이번 패치로 인해 게임 플레이가 더욱 원활해졌습니다. 계속해서 피드백을 주시면 더 나은 게임 경험을 제공할 수 있도록 노력하겠습니다!

notes.title: Version 0.6.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
클라이언트 연료통 씹힘 수정: 클라이언트가 연료통을 먹었을 때 발생하던 씹히는 현상을 수정했습니다.

서버와 클라이언트 연료통 변수 리플리케이션: 서버와 클라이언트 간 연료통 변수를 모두 리플리케이트합니다.

쇼핑몰맵 삐에로의 자연스러운 움직임 개선: 쇼핑몰맵에서 삐에로가 더 자연스러운 움직임을 보이도록 개선했습니다.

개발자 플레이 가능: 가끔 개발자도 게임을 플레이할 수 있습니다. :ㅇ


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fixed Fuel Can Pickup Bug: Fixed an issue where the client would fail to properly pick up fuel cans, causing them to disappear or "ghost."

Fuel Can Replication Improved: All fuel can variables are now fully replicated between the server and client for better sync and stability.

Improved Clown Movement in Mall Map: The clown in the shopping mall map now moves more naturally and believably.

Dev Might Join: Sometimes, the developer might jump in and play too 😏

notes.title: Version 0.6.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
🎉 New Feature: Investor Credits System
We don’t see our players as mere consumers — we see you as investors in the journey we are building together.
With the release of version 0.6.10, we’ve added the names of our early supporters to the ending credits of the game.
This isn’t just a thank-you — it's a permanent acknowledgment of the role you've played in bringing this project to life. 💫

✅ Some of our current players have already had their names added to the credits.
📝 If you'd like to be included as well, all you need to do is leave a positive review.
We regularly check reviews across all platforms and select those that truly reflect heartfelt support.

🔗 Discover Exclusive Benefits
Our relationship with you doesn’t end at purchase — it's just the beginning.
At Ziegler Studio, we aim to cultivate a deeper, more meaningful connection between creators and supporters,
and that’s why we’re offering exclusive rewards beyond the credits system.

📍Visit our official website at https://zieglerstudio.store/ to discover additional benefits

🎉 New Feature: Investor Credits System
우리는 게임을 구매해준 여러분 한 사람 한 사람을 단순한 유저가 아닌, 이 여정을 함께하는 투자자라고 생각해요.
이번 0.6.10 버전부터 엔딩 크레딧에 게임 구매자들의 이름을 추가했어요!
이건 단순한 감사의 표시가 아니라, 우리 게임을 존재하게 만든 여러분을 "진짜로" 남기는 방법이니까요. ✨

✅ 현재까지 게임을 구매한 분들 중 일부는 크레딧에 이름이 추가되었습니다.
📝 앞으로도 이름을 올리고 싶은 분은, 긍정적인 리뷰를 남겨주세요.
우리는 매 패치마다 모든 플랫폼의 리뷰를 확인하고 있으며,
진심이 담긴 리뷰를 남겨준 분들은 크레딧에 등록해드립니다.

🔗 추가 혜택 안내
우리는 여러분과의 관계를 단순한 일회성 구매로 끝내지 않기를 바랍니다.
Ziegler Studio는 게임 개발자와 투자자(유저) 간의 더욱 깊고 정교한 연결을 추구하며,
이에 따라 크레딧 등록 외에도 다양한 맞춤형 리워드와 혜택들을 준비했습니다.

📍자세한 내용은 공식 웹사이트 zieglerstudio.store를 방문해주세요.

notes.title: Version 0.6.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
📌 Major Updates
🔄 Backrooms Level 0 Redesign
Completely redesigned the layout of Level 0.

Lighting, structure, and spatial flow have been reworked to amplify tension and immersion.

The level now offers a fresh sense of unease and requires new approaches to exploration. Watch your step... 🫣

🧠 Interaction System Fixes
Fixed a critical issue where key bindings (especially parent-child bindings) were conflicting.

This bug caused the control panel and other interactions to fail or behave inconsistently.

All interaction-related bindings have now been revised and should work as intended. Buttons should behave now. 😏

🫧 A Note from the Developer
We sincerely apologize for the key binding conflict that may have impacted your experience in previous versions.
It was an oversight on our part, and thanks to your patience and feedback, we were able to identify and resolve it quickly.
We’re committed to rapid bug fixes and continued improvements to ensure a smooth and immersive gameplay experience.
Thank you always for playing and supporting the project. 🙇‍♀️💛

notes.title: Version 0.5.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Features & Updates:

Shopping Mall Map Update

New Character Added: The Clown has arrived at the Shopping Mall! Players can now interact with the Clown, who brings unique events and quirky dialogue.

New Shops & Items: Additional stores have been opened within the mall, offering a wider variety of items to purchase and explore.

Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements:

Addressed some rendering issues and improved overall performance.

This update brings more life and charm to the Shopping Mall map, offering players new experiences and choices. Enjoy the chaos with the new Clown! 🎪🤡

notes.title: Version 0.4.1 Beta Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here's what's new in our latest update, Version 0.4.1 Beta. This patch focuses on improving the accuracy and reliability of player interactions.

Improvements:

More Precise Interactions: We've reworked the interaction system to eliminate a long-standing issue where overlapping the player's hitbox and the interactable actor at the same time would cause strange or unintended behavior. This has now been fixed.

Line Trace Integration: Interactions are now handled using line tracing instead of overlap checks. This change makes interactions significantly more accurate and responsive, reducing false positives and improving the overall feel of gameplay.

This update is all about improving the core experience and making sure interactions feel smooth and intentional. Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates! 💫

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We have an important update today with several optimizations and improvements. Check out the details below:

Key Changes:
Lumen Lighting Optimization

All Lumen lighting systems have been optimized. This results in better performance, providing a smoother overall gameplay experience with improved rendering efficiency.

Map Detail Adjustments

The map has been updated with more refined details. You'll now experience a more immersive and realistic environment.

Map Changes

The layout and structure of certain areas on the map have been modified. New adjustments allow for more engaging exploration and interaction.

Increased Collection Difficulty

The difficulty for collecting resources and items has been increased. Searching for collectibles is now more challenging, offering a greater sense of accomplishment.

Mouse Sensitivity Save Fix

There was an issue where mouse sensitivity settings weren't saving correctly. This has been resolved, and your sensitivity preferences will now be properly saved for smoother control.

Thank you for your feedback! We'll continue improving the game with future updates. 😊

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.9 – Lumen Brightness Tuning & Translation Polish
notes.content:
Fine-tuned Lumen brightness across environments
Adjusted the overall lighting balance to reduce harsh glare and ensure a more natural look in both bright and dark areas.

전반적인 루멘 밝기 밸런스를 조정했어
눈부심을 줄이고, 밝은 곳과 어두운 곳 모두에서 더 자연스럽게 보이도록 개선했어.

Improved lighting transitions in indoor and dynamic scenes
Lighting changes now feel smoother and more immersive, with fewer jarring shifts.

실내 및 동적 씬에서 조명 전환 자연스럽게 개선
갑작스러운 조명 변화가 줄어들고, 몰입감이 더 올라갔어.

Enhanced translation quality
Refined various in-game texts to better reflect tone, context, and clarity in both Korean and English.

게임 내 텍스트 번역 품질 향상
한국어와 영어 모두에서 어투, 문맥, 명확성을 고려해 다듬었어.

Minor reflection and ambient light tweaks
Subtle changes to Lumen reflections and ambient light for a more atmospheric experience.

루멘 반사광 및 주변광 미세 조정
분위기를 살리기 위해 디테일하게 손봤어.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Lumen Optimization & AI Server Sync Improvements v0.3.8
notes.content:
Multiplayer-Specific Lumen Tweaks
Adjusted Lumen behavior in multiplayer environments to reduce unnecessary resource consumption and loading spikes. 

Enhanced AI Server Synchronization
AI behavior is now more accurately and consistently synchronized across clients in multiplayer sessions. No more out-of-sync weirdness
